title: AI Ad Tool That Manages Facebook Campaigns vs an Agency
summary: AI ad tools suit teams that run their own Facebook account. Agencies suit teams that need finished ads and campaign management. Compare Knowlify and Airpost.
body_markdown:
Hire an agency if nobody on your team has the time to brief, review and run Facebook ads every week, and use an AI ad tool if your own media buyer will operate it. Knowlify is our top pick for the agency route: about 25 finished AI video ads a week, a person checking every ad, and a choice of Meta campaign management or creative-only delivery. "Manages Facebook campaigns" covers very different work, from uploading files to setting budgets and audiences, so ask exactly what each vendor touches in your account. Knowlify publishes this guide and sells one of the services compared.


## Which kind of AI ad product are you buying?


Vendors use the same language for three different products. Some sell software that generates creative for your team to choose and download. Others sell a platform with a dedicated team that makes ads and uploads them to your account. A few run the account as a managed service. The table shows how each option describes itself, as of October 2026.


Option Who makes the ads Who runs the campaigns Published price


Knowlify ([Meta ads service](https://knowlify.com/meta-ads-agency) ) Our team: AI UGC presenters, character animation and AI commercials, with a person checking every ad Optional end-to-end management in your Meta account, or creative-only From $5,000 a month


[Airpost](https://www.airpost.ai/pricing) Dedicated AI video team with a custom model for your brand Uploads ads to your Meta account; its homepage describes testing and scale campaigns From $6,000 a month


[Adside AI](https://www.adside.ai/pricing) Creative production included in one managed fee Yes: its managed fee covers strategy, launch, optimization and reporting 10% of ad spend, $3,500 monthly minimum


[Creatify](https://creatify.ai/pricing) Self-serve AI ad software, or a managed Studio Its Studio page does not say whether Studio runs campaigns $15 a month self-serve; Studio $100 to $200 per video


Meta Advantage+ creative AI variations of ads you supply, inside Ads Manager Your team, in Ads Manager No separate price listed


Read "manages campaigns" literally. Ask who logs into your Meta account, who sets budgets and audiences, who writes the test plan, and which party is accountable for each item in the contract.


## Knowlify: our top pick for finished ads with Meta management


Knowlify is the best fit when the real question behind "tool or agency" is who keeps your account supplied with finished ads. We are an agency, not a login: about 25 finished ads a week across AI UGC (AI presenters talking to camera), 3D and character animation, and AI commercials, with the first batch landing on day 5 and a person checking every ad before delivery. You choose the scope: end-to-end Meta campaign management in your own ad account, or creative-only delivery if you already have a media buyer.


Pricing is a custom quote with no public rate card. Where Knowlify runs the account, the guarantee is an agreed target in 30 days, or you don't pay for the month. On creative-only plans, if the ads have not made more than you paid in the first 90 days, you can cancel by email for a full refund ([terms on the site](https://knowlify.com/meta-ads-agency#pricing) ). Our named clients are Parva and Casco, and the[Facebook and Instagram video ad examples](https://knowlify.com/articles/facebook-video-ad-examples) page shows public work.


Pick another option if your ad needs a real customer or creator on camera, since our presenters are AI and we do not post from creator accounts, or if you want software your team operates daily rather than our[done-for-you AI UGC service](https://knowlify.com/ai-ugc-ads) . We also run only Facebook and Instagram ads, not TikTok, LinkedIn, Google or YouTube, and we do not build landing pages.


## Which AI tools also run the account?


Few AI tools touch campaigns directly. Airpost and Adside AI publish a managed role, while Creatify's self-serve plan leaves campaign decisions with you.


### Airpost


As of October 2026, Airpost's pricing page starts at $6,000 a month. That covers its platform, a dedicated AI video production team, a Slack channel and an editor for copy and voiceover. It says it trains a custom model for your brand and uploads ads to your Meta account the way you specify.


Its[homepage](https://www.airpost.ai/) says testing typically takes 10 to 25 percent of spend in your account. Winning ads move into scale campaigns that Airpost creates, while your existing campaigns are left alone. Contract length is not published, so ask for it before you compare.


### Adside AI


Adside AI offers managed work as well as software, so it is not a do-it-yourself tool. Its managed service costs 10 percent of ad spend with a $3,500 monthly minimum. One fee covers strategy, creative production, launch, optimization and reporting. The pricing page does not say how many creatives that fee includes, so ask for the number in writing.


By our arithmetic, 10 percent of spend only exceeds the $3,500 minimum once you spend more than $35,000 a month on ads, so below that the minimum is what you pay. Its[managed-service page](https://www.adside.ai/managed-service) also mentions a first month without a minimum and volume pricing above $500,000 in managed spend, so confirm how those apply in writing. Adside AI is also a different company from AdSide Media.


### Creatify


Creatify's self-serve plan costs $15 a month on monthly billing and includes 55 credits. Its managed Studio runs with a dedicated creative team, 25 to 100 or more videos a month and a 48-hour turnaround. Its comparison table lists Studio at $100 to $200 per video, and the[Studio page](https://creatify.ai/studio) does not say whether Studio runs campaigns, so ask directly.
